# Garrett Potz — Independent Mortgage Broker (Affinity Home Lending)

> Garrett Potz is an independent mortgage broker and Certified Mortgage Advisor (NMLS #631592) at Affinity Home Lending, based in Woodstock, Georgia. He shops 45 lenders across Georgia, Florida, Alabama, Tennessee, and South Carolina, and specializes in self employed and business owner financing (bank statement, 1099, DSCR, and profit and loss loans) alongside conventional, FHA, VA, USDA, jumbo, and refinance loans.

Key facts: Independent broker, not a single bank. Licensed in GA, FL, AL, TN, SC. Self employed specialist. Same person from first call to closing. Phone and text (770) 401-1759. Email gpotz@affinityhomelending.com. Garrett Potz NMLS #631592, Affinity Home Lending Company NMLS #1181151, Georgia Residential Mortgage Licensee #42129, Equal Housing Lender.

## Self employed and business owner financing (specialty)
- [Self Employed Mortgage Guide](https://www.garrettpotz.com/guide-self-employed.html): How self employed borrowers qualify without traditional W-2 income.
- [Bank Statement Loans: How They Work and Who They're For](https://www.garrettpotz.com/blog-bank-statement-loans.html): Qualifying using bank deposits instead of tax returns.
- [Can Self Employed Borrowers Qualify for a Mortgage?](https://www.garrettpotz.com/blog-can-self-employed-qualify.html): Options for business owners and 1099 earners.
- [DSCR Loans for Investors](https://www.garrettpotz.com/blog-dscr-loans-investors.html): Qualifying investment property loans on rental income, not personal income.
